meta.title: WispOps — fleet server operations
meta.description: Manage servers, an independent encrypted credential vault, and per-server recurring tasks in DeepSeek Harness. Includes inspection, disk diagnosis, security triage, fleet commands and per-host approval; WispTerm is optional.

ui.template.chat.prompt:
Help me design a recurring check template for the WispOps task library.{p0}
First confirm with me what to check, the thresholds and a suggested run time, using read-only tools if that helps. Then submit it with ops_template_draft so I can review and save it in the panel.

ui.fleet.one.point: At least two successful inspections are needed for a trend.
ui.fleet.unreachable.row: The host could not be inspected at this time.
ui.credential.username.hint: SSH login uses the server's configured user. For sudo, a different username opens a separate SSH connection using this credential; leave blank to keep the login account.
ui.sudo.account.connection: sudo account: {p0}. If it differs from the SSH login account, this credential is used for a separate SSH login and sudo authentication.
ui.sudo.account.current.login: sudo uses the server's SSH login account. The selected password is used only for sudo authentication.
ui.sudo.account.login.failed: SSH login for the sudo check failed. Check the sudo credential's username and password, and whether that account is allowed to log in over SSH.
ui.encrypted.on.save.never.shown.again: Encrypted on save; never shown in the panel or sent to the model again.

ui.after.saving.this.credential.will.be: After saving, this credential will be linked to {p0} for {p1}.

ui.sudo.works.as: sudo works on {p1}; commands run as {p0}.

ui.sudo.rejected.the.password.or.needs: sudo rejected the password or needs one. Check this credential or the server's sudo rules.
ui.logins.are.paused.after.repeated.failure: Logins to this server are paused after repeated failures. Try again later.
ui.the.test.command.failed: Connected, but the test command failed.
ui.decided.by.host.group.then.default: Decided per capability by host policy, then group, then the plugin default. Model-side deny lists still apply.
ui.allow.runs.without.asking.ask: allow runs without asking, ask requires your approval each time, deny refuses. Inherited values come from this host's YAML policy, its groups and the plugin default.

ui.overrides.apply.to.yaml.hosts.too: Panel settings are stored in managed.json and override the same capability for a same-named server in YAML or WispTerm. They apply on the next call and travel with device sync.
ui.no.run.time.only.run.once: No run time. Run it from the task card with "Run once" or with /ops-run.

ui.ssh.import.title: Import servers from ssh_config
ui.ssh.import.hint: Literal Host entries in {p0} and the files it includes. Imported servers connect through their alias, so keys, ProxyJump and other options stay in ssh_config; wildcard patterns are skipped.
ui.ssh.import.empty: No importable Host entries were found.
ui.probe.done: Probed {p0} server(s); {p1} could not be reached.
ui.not.probed: Not probed yet. Probe to record the OS, GPUs, scheduler, Docker and sudo availability.
ui.missed.run.detail: Due {p0}, with no run recorded since. Check that Harness and the report session were open; use Run once to catch up.
ui.read.only.commands.hint: One per line, run on every linked server before the report is written; only commands that classify as read-only are accepted. A custom task can collect its own evidence this way.

ui.task.notify.on.change.hint: Skip delivery when the problem counts equal the previous run; the first run always delivers.
